text: I'm minding a 6 year old boy overnight and I'm a bit scared. He's had a little cough and runny poos since yesterday, but he's drinking loads and weeing like normal. His cheeks went bright red after we were out in that freezing wind this afternoon. They've calmed right down now he's warm, and when I pressed a glass on them they went pale. No other spots on him anywhere. No fits or shaking either. Sorry, I just don't want to get it wrong.
